recap.text: Burgundy, a dark-haired assistant with one blue eye and one brown eye, works for Miss Quill. Remex cursed her to be human by day and a monster at night. Princess Donut hits her with a Magic Missile to kill her before the roof caves in.

beats.headline: On the magistrate's stairs
beats.text: For the record: in the skyfowl mall below the magistrate's quarters, a human carrying a blue folder of papers rushes up the stairs, then back down, almost into the crawlers. "Pardon me." The name over her head: Burgundy. Young, dark-haired, pretty, with one pale blue eye and one brown, like a Siberian husky. Are they lost? They do not see many of their kind up here. They are going to see the magistrate. She snorts. "Good luck." Her blue folder is on Miss Quill's desk.
beats.gist: Burgundy, a dark-haired human with one pale blue eye and one brown, rushes past the crawlers.

beats.headline: Healing would undo her
beats.text: The magistrate's building is coming apart when one of the burnt, headless corpses flickers from X to red to white. Her head has magically returned to her body, and the system calls her human. The lower half of her is char. The eyes identify her: Burgundy, from the stairs. Crawler Carl pulls a healing potion. No: healing her would heal her body, and she would turn into one of those things again. She is cursed. The kindest thing is to kill her while she is still mortal. "Hurry. Please. It hurts."
beats.gist: Burgundy is a cursed assistant whom Carl kills to stop her pain.

beats.headline: The job at the club
beats.text: A person by day and one of those things at night, she confirms. The elves brought her from another settlement with a promise of work at the Desperado Club. Everyone knows a job there is a chance to descend: to the Hunting Grounds, then maybe deeper, where it is safe. It was all a lie. Asked whether she was a prostitute: yes, and if they do not like it, fuck off. She has stabbed men for less. Crawler Donut's torch keeps the curse back, and she can feel it fading.
beats.gist: Burgundy confirms she is a person by day and something else at night.

beats.headline: Her husband, across the street
beats.text: Featherfall did not do this. He hangs on that thing, dead before she arrived, turned into a dark fetish that keeps their bodies safe at night. Miss Quill is the real magistrate. Quill took Burgundy from the temple to her husband, Remex, across the street above where the guards sleep: not alive, not dead, casting a big spell to bring himself fully back. By day the women work in the building and the shops below, plucking a feather from every skyfowl or chickadee customer for Quill. At night they are his army.
beats.gist: Quill took Burgundy from the temple to Remex, who hangs as a dark fetish across the street.

beats.headline: The ones who do not turn
beats.text: The women in the alleys, she says, are those whose sins are not enough. They came to work at the Desperado Club, and when Remex twists them they do not always turn. Sometimes they simply die. Then the survivors are allowed to feed on them, and one of his avatars drops them in the alleys, within a few blocks of his lair. The avatars are his limbs, but they cannot go far. Not yet.
beats.gist: Burgundy says Remex twists women from the Desperado Club who do not turn and simply die.

beats.headline: Before the floor goes
beats.text: Final entry for Burgundy, magistrate's assistant, whom the system filed as human. The room slumps forward and her body begins to slide away as the roof above her caves in. "Kill me, please!" Crawler Princess Donut hits her with a Magic Missile in the moments before the body disappears into the collapse. She had asked for exactly that twice, while the torch still held her curse back and she was mortal.
beats.gist: Princess Donut hits Burgundy, a magistrate's assistant, with a Magic Missile before the roof caves in.
